cards.ex: The police suspect it was an inside job because the security system was disabled.
cards.exUz: Politsiya bu ichki ish bo'lgan deb gumon qilmoqda, chunki xavfsizlik tizimi o'chirilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat, odatda o'g'irlik, tashkilot ichidagi odamlar tomonidan sodir etilgan.

cards.ex: He was charged as an accessory to the crime, even though he didn't pull the trigger.
cards.exUz: U jinoyatga sherik sifatida ayblangan, garchi u tetikni bosmagan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatga yordam bergan yoki uni yashirishga uringan shaxs.

cards.ex: She got the job because she has a clean record and excellent references.
cards.exUz: U ishni oldi, chunki uning begunoh o'tmishi va ajoyib tavsiyanomalari bor.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday jinoyat yozuvi bo'lmagan odam.

cards.ex: The prosecutor decided to drop the charges due to lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Prokuror dalillar yetishmasligi sababli ayblovlarni olib tashlashga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: The judge took the extenuating circumstances into account when sentencing him.
cards.exUz: Sudya uni hukm qilayotganda yumshatuvchi holatlarni hisobga oldi.

cards.ex: The rule of law is fundamental to a just and fair society.
cards.exUz: Qonun ustuvorligi adolatli va haqqoniy jamiyat uchun asosdir.

cards.ex: You have the right to remain silent; anything you say can be used against you.
cards.exUz: Siz jim turish huquqiga egasiz; aytgan har qanday gapingiz sizga qarshi ishlatilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hibsdagi odamning savollarga javob bermaslik huquqi.

cards.ex: Her conduct as a judge was beyond reproach; everyone respected her integrity.
cards.exUz: Uning sudya sifatidagi xatti-harakatlari aybsiz edi; hamma uning halolligini hurmat qilardi.

cards.ex: It's the police's job to uphold the law and protect citizens.
cards.exUz: Politsiyaning vazifasi qonunni qo'llab-quvvatlash va fuqarolarni himoya qilishdir.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni himoya qilish, unga rioya qilishni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: The wrongly convicted man's release was a step towards correcting a serious miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri hukm qilingan odamning ozod qilinishi adolatning buzilishini tuzatish yo'lidagi qadam edi.

cards.ex: He was arrested for statutory rape after having a relationship with a 15-year-old girl.
cards.exUz: U 15 yoshli qiz bilan munosabatda bo'lganidan keyin voyaga yetmagan bilan jinsiy aloqa qilgani uchun hibsga olingan.
cards.uzDef: Voyaga yetmagan shaxs bilan jinsiy aloqa qilish jinoyati.

cards.ex: Witnesses are required to testify under oath to ensure the truth is told.
cards.exUz: Guvohlar haqiqat aytilishini ta'minlash uchun qasamyod bilan guvohlik berishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rost gapirishga qasamyod qilib guvohlik berish.

cards.ex: His behavior in court was beyond the pale; he was completely disrespectful.
cards.exUz: Uning suddagi xatti-harakatlari qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan edi; u butunlay hurmatsizlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan, haddan tashqari yomon.

cards.ex: The judge will hand down a sentence next week after considering all the evidence.
cards.exUz: Sudya barcha dalillarni ko'rib chiqqandan so'ng, kelasi hafta hukm chiqaradi.

cards.ex: The case is currently on appeal, so the original verdict is not final.
cards.exUz: Ish hozirda apellyatsiya bo'yicha ko'rilmoqda, shuning uchun dastlabki hukm yakuniy emas.

cards.ex: The lawyer objected to the leading question, arguing it was unfair to the witness.
cards.exUz: Advokat yo'naltiruvchi savolga e'tiroz bildirdi va bu guvohga nisbatan adolatsizlik ekanligini aytdi.

cards.ex: He decided to waive his rights and speak to the police without a lawyer present.
cards.exUz: U huquqlaridan voz kechishga va advokatsiz politsiya bilan gaplashishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z huquqlaridan ixtiyoriy ravishda voz kechish.

cards.ex: She was held in contempt of court for refusing to answer the judge's questions.
cards.exUz: U sudya savollariga javob berishdan bosh tortgani uchun sudga hurmatsizlikda ayblanib hibsga olingan.

cards.ex: The evidence proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that he was guilty.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning aybdor ekanligini hech qanday shubhasiz isbotladi.
cards.term: beyond a shadow of a doubt

cards.ex: The company had to foot the bill for the legal fees after the lawsuit.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya da'vodan keyin advokatlik to'lovlarini to'lashga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The case relied heavily on circumstantial evidence, as there were no direct witnesses.
cards.exUz: Ish to'g'ridan-to'g'ri guvohlar yo'qligi sababli, bilvosita dalillarga asoslangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy faktni isbotlash uchun ishlatiladigan dalil.

cards.ex: He accepted a plea bargain to avoid a longer prison sentence.
cards.exUz: U uzoqroq qamoq jazosidan qochish uchun kelishuvni qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayonini oldini olish uchun aybdorlikni tan olish.

cards.ex: You have a cooling-off period of 14 days to cancel the contract.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani bekor qilish uchun sizda 14 kunlik o'ylab ko'rish vaqti bor.
cards.uzDef: Shartnomadan voz kechish uchun berilgan vaqt.

cards.ex: The company wants to avoid litigation if possible and find an amicable solution.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya iloji boricha sud jarayonidan qochishni va do'stona yechim topishni xohlaydi.

cards.ex: This case is being seen as a test case for the new environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Bu ish yangi ekologik qoidalarni sinovdan o'tkazish uchun ko'rilmoqda.

cards.ex: He couldn't be tried again for the same crime because of double jeopardy.
cards.exUz: U bir xil jinoyat uchun qayta sudlanishi mumkin emas, chunki ikki karra jazo qo'llanilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil jinoyat uchun ikki marta jazolanmaslik huquqi.

cards.ex: The mayor is currently under investigation for corruption.
cards.exUz: Hozirda shahar hokimi korruptsiya bo'yicha tekshiruv ostida.

cards.ex: The lawyer objected to the testimony as hearsay, arguing it was inadmissible.
cards.exUz: Advokat guvohlikka e'tiroz bildirdi, chunki u eshitilgan gap bo'lib, qabul qilinishi mumkin emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamdan eshitilgan, ishonchli bo'lmagan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: She was nervous about taking the stand but knew she had to tell the truth.
cards.exUz: U guvohlik berishdan qo'rqardi, lekin haqiqatni aytishi kerakligini bilardi.

cards.ex: The judge issued a gag order to prevent details of the case from leaking to the press.
cards.exUz: Sudya ish tafsilotlarining matbuotga sizib chiqishini oldini olish uchun og'izni yopish buyrug'ini chiqardi.
